events.title: HIRE – Corporate Mock Interview Challenge 2026
events.speakers: 21 interviewers (11 industry experts and 10 alumni) from TAFE, MPloyChek, Momentive Performance Materials, CareerTree HR Solutions, UBTI, APL Logistics, DHL Logistics, X-Press Feeders, V.Ships, MIOT International Hospital, Vestas, Bird Farm Digital Marketing, State Street, Wipro and Valeo
events.note: 240 MBA learners · Lattice Hall · Coordinated by Dr. R. Divya Ranjani and Dr. S. Poorani
events.summary: 21 interviewers (11 industry experts and 10 alumni) from TAFE, MPloyChek, Momentive Performance Materials, CareerTree HR Solutions, UBTI, APL Logistics, DHL Logistics, X-Press Feeders, V.Ships, MIOT International Hospital, Vestas, Bird Farm Digital Marketing, State Street, Wipro and Valeo
events.body:
The Department of Management Studies, Saveetha Engineering College (Autonomous), organised “HIRE – Corporate Mock Interview Challenge 2026” on 22 August 2026 at Lattice Hall, Saveetha Engineering College, Chennai. The programme was coordinated by Dr. R. Divya Ranjani and Dr. S. Poorani to provide MBA students with real-time corporate interview experience.

A total of 240 MBA learners participated in this industry-integrated experiential learning initiative. The event brought together 21 professionals, comprising 11 industry experts and 10 alumni, from diverse sectors. The interview panels represented Human Resources, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Business Analytics, Logistics, Shipping, Technology and Hospital Administration.

The initiative focused on enhancing students’ communication, confidence, professional etiquette, domain knowledge and interview readiness. It also strengthened industry–academia interaction and alumni engagement while preparing students for future internship and placement opportunities.

events.speakers: Ms. Swarna Shreya, SEC alumna (B.E. 2016–2020), full-time MBA candidate, Fisher College of Business, The Ohio State University

events.summary: Ms. Swarna Shreya, SEC alumna (B.E. 2016–2020), full-time MBA candidate, Fisher College of Business, The Ohio State University
events.body:
The Department of Management Studies, Saveetha Engineering College, organised an Alumni Talk titled “Beyond the MBA: Turning Your Degree into Direction” on 10 August 2026, featuring Ms. Swarna Shreya, alumna (B.E. 2016–2020) and Full-Time MBA Candidate at The Ohio State University.

The session provided valuable insights into career planning, industry expectations, skill development, leadership, communication, KPIs and practical applications of MBA knowledge. Coordinated by Dr. R. Divya Ranjani and Dr. S. Poorani, the programme witnessed 136 participants.

The interactive session helped students understand career opportunities, develop a growth mindset and gain clarity on transforming their MBA qualification into meaningful career directions.

events.title: Publishing in High-Quality Marketing Journals: The Path(s) to Acceptance
events.speakers: Prof. Babu (Lourduraj) John-Mariadoss, J.B. Hoskins Professor of Marketing, Rawls College of Business, Texas Tech University
events.note: FinTech Lab · Marketing Stream · Organised by Dr. S. Catherine Rex
events.summary: An FDP led by Prof. Babu John-Mariadoss of Rawls College of Business, Texas Tech University.
events.body:
The Department of Management Studies, Saveetha Engineering College, under the Marketing Stream, organised a Faculty Development Programme (FDP) titled “Publishing in High-Quality Marketing Journals: The Path(s) to Acceptance” on 11 July 2026 at the FinTech Lab.

The programme was organised by Dr. S. Catherine Rex and featured Prof. Babu (Lourduraj) John-Mariadoss, J.B. Hoskins Professor of Marketing, Rawls College of Business, Texas Tech University, as the resource person.

The session provided valuable insights into research paper development, journal selection, publication strategies and the expectations of high-quality marketing journals. It aimed to strengthen faculty research capabilities and enhance their understanding of successful academic publishing practices.

events.title: Campus to Career: Crafting Your Pathway to Success
events.speakers: Ms. V. Keerthana, Associate (Reconciliation), State Street
events.summary: Ms. V. Keerthana, Associate (Reconciliation), State Street
events.body:
The Department of Management Studies organised an alumni talk titled Campus to Career: Crafting Your Pathway to Success on 7 February 2026 at Lattice Hall. The session, aligned with SDG 4 – Quality Education, drew 230 MBA students and aimed to bridge academic learning and professional expectations.

Ms. V. Keerthana, a 2022–2024 alumna of the department and now Associate (Reconciliation) at State Street, spoke about moving from campus to corporate life, the early-career challenges she faced and the strategies that helped her overcome them. The talk covered communication, teamwork, analytical thinking, professional ethics and lifelong learning, and students cleared their career-related queries.
